ideas.text: An AI that translates 'challenging quarter' into the specific number that made it challenging.
A bot that detects when an all-hands announcement requires 4 slides to say what 1 sentence would have covered.
An app that measures the gap between what was promised at last quarter's all-hands and what was delivered.
A tool that detects when the anonymous Q&A moderator skipped the third most-upvoted question and names it.
An AI that converts 'we're excited about what's ahead' into a probability distribution of things that might be ahead.
A bot that detects when a company value is cited in an all-hands slide while a behavior contradicting it was visible last week.
An app that tracks all-hands viewer dropout rate in real time and displays it to the presenter at the 15-minute mark.
A tool that identifies how many times 'our people are our greatest asset' has been said per headcount reduction.
An AI that detects when a live product demo is about to fail and offers a pre-recorded backup with 30 seconds' notice.
A bot that monitors the Slack channel during an all-hands and summarizes employee sentiment in real time for HR.
An app that detects when an all-hands Q&A answer was clearly prepared in advance and marks it as scripted.
A tool that converts a 60-slide all-hands deck into the 8 things employees actually needed to know.
An AI that detects when leadership has scheduled an all-hands on a day guaranteed to ensure low attendance.
A bot that generates a post-all-hands summary for people who attended and still have no idea what changed.
An app that detects when the same question has been asked at 3 consecutive all-hands and still hasn't been answered.
A tool that identifies which executives' all-hands sections consistently cause employee confusion and suggests brevity.
An AI that translates 'we're all in this together' into whether that includes the executive bonus structure.
A bot that detects when news shared at an all-hands was already known by 30% of attendees through the grapevine.
An app that monitors camera reactions during an all-hands and alerts the presenter when the audience looks like they're in a waiting room.
A tool that detects when an all-hands was called to share good news but the energy reads as defensive.
An AI that converts all-hands presentation language into what the company would say if it weren't trying to manage perception.
A bot that counts how many action items were promised at the all-hands and checks how many were completed before the next one.
An app that detects when an all-hands included a values exercise that most employees will have forgotten by Monday.
A tool that identifies which business unit's update was most obviously added for political balance rather than relevance.
An AI that detects when an all-hands slide mentions headcount growth in a quarter when 8 people were quietly let go.
A bot that detects when the CEO's opening remarks run 22 minutes and the entire rest of the company gets 8.
An app that converts the all-hands applause slide into a list of things employees actually want to applaud.
A tool that detects when a new executive's introduction takes longer than the update on the company's actual situation.
An AI that generates 3 smart all-hands questions for employees who want to seem engaged without revealing anything.
A bot that detects when the all-hands was clearly designed to prevent panic and estimates whether it worked.
An app that tracks which initiatives announced at all-hands events were still being discussed 6 months later.
A tool that measures how much of the all-hands was dedicated to the past versus the future versus the actual right now.
An AI that detects when a company rebrands its slide template for an all-hands right after something went wrong.
A bot that identifies when an all-hands announcement was made to preempt a press article that's about to drop.
An app that monitors the Glassdoor review spike that follows every company all-hands and correlates it with the topics covered.
A tool that detects when the innovation update is about a feature that was due 14 months ago.
An AI that converts all-hands 'learnings' slides into a list of things the company will probably do again.
A bot that detects when the all-hands is being recorded and the presenter's energy visibly changes.
An app that counts how many people submitted anonymous questions and how many were actually read aloud.
A tool that detects when an all-hands ended without telling anyone what they should do differently starting tomorrow.
An AI that predicts whether the all-hands will be followed by a Slack message asking 'wait what did that mean.'
A bot that detects when a company milestone is being celebrated at the same moment its main users are unhappy.
An app that converts the all-hands recording link into a 5-minute summary with timestamps for the two parts that mattered.
A tool that identifies which departments got name-dropped at the all-hands and which ones were invisible again.
An AI that detects when a 'town hall format' all-hands has a moderator filtering out questions in real time.
A bot that tracks how many all-hands events your company has held this year and what percentage produced a visible action.
An app that sends you the 3 things you should know from the all-hands you missed without having to watch the recording.
A tool that detects when an all-hands was scheduled 3 days after a competitor announcement and reads the correlation.
An AI that estimates how much of the all-hands energy came from genuine confidence versus communications coaching.
A bot that detects when 'we'll share more as we learn more' is being used to avoid sharing something that is already known.
An app that generates the Slack message your team will inevitably send each other during the all-hands, preemptively.
An AI that detects when 'we'll share more details soon' has been said for 3 consecutive all-hands and files a status request.
A bot that generates a bingo card for your company's all-hands based on the phrases used in the last 3 of them.
An app that detects when the all-hands was clearly planned for 4 hours but has 90 minutes of actual content.
A tool that tracks which all-hands slide got the most questions and infers what leadership should have addressed directly.
An AI that monitors energy levels at an all-hands via camera engagement and shows the drop-off point to the AV team.
A bot that converts an all-hands recording into a 3-paragraph summary for everyone who had a conflict and is pretending they didn't.
